  - Aggregates all lines by their VAT rate across all qualifying invoices
  - Sorted from high to low VAT rate

  - Line and tier discounts

  - Zero VAT rate handling
  - Multiple lines per invoice
  - Large datasets
  - Precision and non-mutation
